metadata.title: Rucaparib (Tablets) Monotherapy
metadata.indication: First-line maintenance for adults with advanced FIGO III–IV high-grade epithelial ovarian cancer in complete or partial response after first-line platinum-based chemotherapy. First-line maintenance for adults with advanced FIGO III–IV high-grade epithelial fallopian tube cancer in complete or partial response after first-line platinum-based chemotherapy. First-line maintenance for adults with advanced FIGO III–IV high-grade epithelial primary peritoneal cancer in complete or partial response after first-line platinum-based chemotherapy.
metadata.partial_assessment_note: Any independently actionable entered value is assessed; omitted domains remain unassessed and do not block a partial result.
metadata.partial_assessment_policy: Each entered value is assessed independently. Omitted domains remain unassessed and are never assumed normal.

catalogue_reconciliation.scope_note: The NCCP states that its website list is not comprehensive. This reconciliation does not assert that every possible national regimen is published online.

clinical_governance.prescriptive_authority: Treatment plan must be initiated by a Consultant Medical Oncologist or the specialist authority specified in the current NCCP source.
clinical_governance.dose_modification_note: Use the most restrictive applicable component rule and confirm all dose changes against the current official NCCP PDF.
clinical_governance.disclaimer: Decision support derived from NCCP 00904 v2. The prescriber must verify the current protocol and individual patient circumstances. Independent clinical and pharmacy validation is pending.

indications.description: First-line maintenance for adults with advanced FIGO III–IV high-grade epithelial ovarian cancer in complete or partial response after first-line platinum-based chemotherapy.
First-line maintenance for adults with advanced FIGO III–IV high-grade epithelial fallopian tube cancer in complete or partial response after first-line platinum-based chemotherapy.
First-line maintenance for adults with advanced FIGO III–IV high-grade epithelial primary peritoneal cancer in complete or partial response after first-line platinum-based chemotherapy.

treatment.schedule_summary: Continuous twice-daily oral therapy, approximately 12 hours apart, for up to 2 years, stopping earlier for progression or unacceptable toxicity. Start within 8 weeks of the final dose of first-line platinum. A 28-day calendar is a tracking interval.

known_hypersensitivity.label: Known hypersensitivity to treatment or its excipients

renal_input.reason: Use the measured result to compare the source-specific threshold for the selected treatment visit and individual drug.

options.label: Grade 2
options.description: Moderate; intervention may be indicated and instrumental activities may be limited.

options.label: Grade 3
options.description: Severe or medically significant; hospital care may be indicated and self-care may be limited.

non_haematological_toxicity_grade.assessment_guidance: Identify the named toxicity and grade it using the applicable CTCAE term rather than a generic impression.

held_for_counts.label: Treatment currently interrupted for low counts

action.message: Known hypersensitivity is an exclusion. Review the culprit medicine or excipient.

rules.explanation: Known hypersensitivity is an exclusion. Review the culprit medicine or excipient.

action.message: First-line maintenance should start within eight weeks of the final platinum dose. Confirm eligibility and the treatment plan.

rules.explanation: First-line maintenance should start within eight weeks of the final platinum dose. Confirm eligibility and the treatment plan.

action.message: The two-year maximum has been reached. Review the stop date before further prescribing.
action.recommendation: The two-year maximum has been reached. Review the stop date before further prescribing.

rules.explanation: The two-year maximum has been reached. Review the stop date before further prescribing.

action.message: Confirm complete or partial response to first-line platinum chemotherapy, qualifying cancer site, high-grade histology and FIGO III–IV stage.

rules.explanation: Confirm complete or partial response to first-line platinum chemotherapy, qualifying cancer site, high-grade histology and FIGO III–IV stage.

action.message: The NCCP entry criterion is ECOG 0–1. Review with the treating consultant.

rules.explanation: The NCCP entry criterion is ECOG 0–1. Review with the treating consultant.

action.message: Breastfeeding is excluded during treatment and for two weeks after the final dose.

rules.explanation: Breastfeeding is excluded during treatment and for two weeks after the final dose.

action.message: For severe renal impairment use only when anticipated benefit outweighs risk. Table 3 expects no adjustment for CrCl <30 or haemodialysis. Discuss eligibility, adverse effects and monitoring with the consultant.
action.recommendation: For severe renal impairment use only when anticipated benefit outweighs risk. Table 3 expects no adjustment for CrCl <30 or haemodialysis. Discuss eligibility, adverse effects and monitoring with the consultant.

rules.explanation: For severe renal impairment use only when anticipated benefit outweighs risk. Table 3 expects no adjustment for CrCl <30 or haemodialysis. Discuss eligibility, adverse effects and monitoring with the consultant.

action.message: Rucaparib is not recommended in severe hepatic impairment.

rules.explanation: Rucaparib is not recommended in severe hepatic impairment.

action.message: Refer promptly to haematology for investigation of suspected MDS/AML, including marrow and cytogenetics as appropriate.
action.recommendation: Refer promptly to haematology for investigation of suspected MDS/AML, including marrow and cytogenetics as appropriate.

rules.explanation: Refer promptly to haematology for investigation of suspected MDS/AML, including marrow and cytogenetics as appropriate.

action.message: Permanently discontinue rucaparib for confirmed MDS or AML.

rules.explanation: Permanently discontinue rucaparib for confirmed MDS or AML.

action.message: Interrupt rucaparib; repeat the full blood count weekly until recovery. Check all three values.

rules.explanation: Interrupt rucaparib; repeat the full blood count weekly until recovery. Check all three values.

action.message: Maintain the interruption and check counts weekly. Recovery requires ANC ≥1.5, haemoglobin ≥9 g/dL and platelets ≥100 ×10⁹/L. Assess duration of cytopenia.

rules.explanation: Maintain the interruption and check counts weekly. Recovery requires ANC ≥1.5, haemoglobin ≥9 g/dL and platelets ≥100 ×10⁹/L. Assess duration of cytopenia.

action.message: The blood counts have not recovered after four weeks. Discontinue rucaparib and refer to the consultant for further investigation.

rules.explanation: The blood counts have not recovered after four weeks. Discontinue rucaparib and refer to the consultant for further investigation.

action.message: Obtain ANC, haemoglobin and platelets before judging recovery and authorising restart.
action.recommendation: Obtain ANC, haemoglobin and platelets before judging recovery and authorising restart.

rules.explanation: Obtain ANC, haemoglobin and platelets before judging recovery and authorising restart.

action.message: All haematological recovery thresholds are met. After consultant review restart one level down, from 600 mg to 500 mg twice daily.

rules.explanation: All haematological recovery thresholds are met. After consultant review restart one level down, from 600 mg to 500 mg twice daily.

action.message: All haematological recovery thresholds are met. After consultant review restart one level down, from 500 mg to 400 mg twice daily.

rules.explanation: All haematological recovery thresholds are met. After consultant review restart one level down, from 500 mg to 400 mg twice daily.

action.message: All haematological recovery thresholds are met. After consultant review restart one level down, from 400 mg to 300 mg twice daily.

rules.explanation: All haematological recovery thresholds are met. After consultant review restart one level down, from 400 mg to 300 mg twice daily.

action.message: Recovery thresholds are met, but no lower NCCP dose level is listed below 300 mg twice daily. Seek a prescribing decision before restarting.
action.recommendation: Recovery thresholds are met, but no lower NCCP dose level is listed below 300 mg twice daily. Seek a prescribing decision before restarting.

rules.explanation: Recovery thresholds are met, but no lower NCCP dose level is listed below 300 mg twice daily. Seek a prescribing decision before restarting.

action.message: Confirm the last dose before restarting one level lower after recovery.
action.recommendation: Confirm the last dose before restarting one level lower after recovery.

rules.explanation: Confirm the last dose before restarting one level lower after recovery.

action.message: Interrupt if transaminases fail to decline within two weeks. Wait for recovery to grade ≤2, then the prescriber may resume at the same or a reduced dose.

rules.explanation: Interrupt if transaminases fail to decline within two weeks. Wait for recovery to grade ≤2, then the prescriber may resume at the same or a reduced dose.

action.message: Grade 3 isolated transaminase elevation meets the bilirubin and alkaline phosphatase conditions. Monitor weekly until grade ≤2. Interrupt if no improvement within two weeks.

rules.explanation: Grade 3 isolated transaminase elevation meets the bilirubin and alkaline phosphatase conditions. Monitor weekly until grade ≤2. Interrupt if no improvement within two weeks.

action.message: The criteria for continuing isolated grade 3 AST/ALT elevation are unconfirmed. Check other liver dysfunction, bilirubin <ULN, ALP <3×ULN, and the two-week trend before prescribing.
action.recommendation: The criteria for continuing isolated grade 3 AST/ALT elevation are unconfirmed. Check other liver dysfunction, bilirubin <ULN, ALP <3×ULN, and the two-week trend before prescribing.

rules.explanation: The criteria for continuing isolated grade 3 AST/ALT elevation are unconfirmed. Check other liver dysfunction, bilirubin <ULN, ALP <3×ULN, and the two-week trend before prescribing.

action.message: Interrupt rucaparib for grade 4 AST/ALT elevation. Resume only after recovery to grade ≤2 at a reduced dose; monitor weekly for three weeks after restarting.

rules.explanation: Interrupt rucaparib for grade 4 AST/ALT elevation. Resume only after recovery to grade ≤2 at a reduced dose; monitor weekly for three weeks after restarting.

action.message: Following a grade 3 interruption and recovery to grade ≤2, agree restart at the same or a reduced dose.
action.recommendation: Following a grade 3 interruption and recovery to grade ≤2, agree restart at the same or a reduced dose.

rules.explanation: Following a grade 3 interruption and recovery to grade ≤2, agree restart at the same or a reduced dose.

action.message: Following grade 4 elevation and recovery to grade ≤2, agree a reduced dose and monitor liver tests weekly for three weeks.
action.recommendation: A lower dose is required after grade 4 recovery. Confirm the previous prescription and agreed lower level; check liver tests weekly for three weeks.

rules.explanation: Following grade 4 elevation and recovery to grade ≤2, agree a reduced dose and monitor liver tests weekly for three weeks.

action.message: If symptomatic care is inadequate, interrupt and/or reduce rucaparib as clinically indicated. Use the published dose levels.
action.recommendation: If symptomatic care is inadequate, interrupt and/or reduce rucaparib as clinically indicated. Use the published dose levels.

rules.explanation: If symptomatic care is inadequate, interrupt and/or reduce rucaparib as clinically indicated. Use the published dose levels.

eligibility: First-line maintenance for adults with advanced FIGO III–IV high-grade epithelial ovarian cancer in complete or partial response after first-line platinum-based chemotherapy.
First-line maintenance for adults with advanced FIGO III–IV high-grade epithelial fallopian tube cancer in complete or partial response after first-line platinum-based chemotherapy.
First-line maintenance for adults with advanced FIGO III–IV high-grade epithelial primary peritoneal cancer in complete or partial response after first-line platinum-based chemotherapy.
ECOG 0–1 and adequate blood counts and organ function.
exclusions: Hypersensitivity to rucaparib or an excipient.
Breastfeeding during treatment and for two weeks after the final dose.

supportive_care.mapping_basis: Highest emetogenic active component and phase-specific NCCP classification.

administration.note: Twice every day, approximately 12 hours apart. Continue across calendar boundaries.

notes: Continuous twice-daily oral therapy, approximately 12 hours apart, for up to 2 years, stopping earlier for progression or unacceptable toxicity. Start within 8 weeks of the final dose of first-line platinum. A 28-day calendar is a tracking interval.
treatment_phases.label: Continuous · morning and evening tablets
treatment_phases.duration_text: Daily until progression or unacceptable toxicity, for a maximum of two years.
